features.name: log_income_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed income normalized by training mean and std to create a smooth continuous score centered around zero, useful for linear margins
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces skewness of income distribution, enabling linear SVM to find better separating hyperplanes in income space

features.name: loop_ratio
features.description: Ratio of looped transactions to total count, measuring the proportion of circular transaction patterns which may indicate ransomware behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures circular transaction behavior as a normalized ratio, directly interpretable by linear SVM as a continuous severity measure

features.name: log_count_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed transaction count normalized to [0,1] range using training min/max of log values
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized transaction volume score suitable for linear SVM margin optimization

features.name: weight_per_neighbor
features.description: Transaction weight divided by number of neighbors, measuring average weight concentration per connected address
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures weight concentration in the transaction network, useful for detecting anomalous fund flows per connection

features.name: log_weight_score
features.description: Log-transformed weight clipped and normalized to handle extreme values and near-zero weights
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized weight score reduces influence of extreme outliers while preserving ordering, improving linear SVM convergence

features.name: length_normalized
features.description: Transaction chain length normalized by maximum observed length to create a [0,1] severity score
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized chain length provides a smooth continuous feature for linear SVM to detect unusually long transaction chains

features.name: day_cyclical_sin
features.description: Sine transformation of day-of-year to capture cyclical temporal patterns in a continuous smooth feature
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes seasonal/cyclical temporal patterns as a smooth continuous value, enabling linear SVM to detect time-based behavioral patterns

features.name: income_per_transaction
features.description: Log of income divided by transaction count, measuring average income per transaction as a normalized efficiency score
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures income concentration per transaction, useful for detecting high-value concentrated fund flows characteristic of ransomware

features.name: neighbor_count_ratio
features.description: Log ratio of neighbors to count, measuring network connectivity relative to transaction volume
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relationship between network breadth and transaction volume, useful for detecting sparse high-volume or dense low-volume patterns

features.name: composite_anomaly_score
features.description: Weighted composite of normalized loop ratio, log weight, and length features to create an aggregate anomaly severity score
features.expected_model_benefit: Single composite feature approximating a linear projection of multiple behavioral signals, directly useful as a margin feature for linear SVM

features.name: transaction_density_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of transaction density combining count, neighbors, and looped values to score how densely interconnected and active the transaction pattern is on a 0-10 scale
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a human-interpretable density score that captures complex interaction patterns between network topology and transaction volume for linear SVM

features.name: temporal_activity_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of temporal activity pattern based on day-of-year, scoring how unusual or concentrated the timing of transactions is relative to typical annual patterns, on a 0-10 scale
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures temporal anomalies in transaction timing that may indicate coordinated ransomware campaigns, providing a smooth continuous score for linear SVM
